flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui utils/Meta/System.ts (Postpone Court menu entry without Route), App.tsx (/system block), utils/models/Istandardcode.d.ts; ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsCourtCase/OcmsCourtCase, crud/ocmsizdb/parameter/ParameterController, api-authorization.properties; ocmseserviceapi crud/beans/SystemConstant (ID types). ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no e-adjournment code
note: Sheet status: 'Requirement given - Gen flow' (a written requirement exists, no OCMS flow deck). There is no e-adjournment code: the word adjourn and its variants do not appear in the six repos, and there is no route, entity, controller, flag or parameter, and no configuration per ID type (N, F, P, B). ID types are recognised in furnish and search, and the generic Parameter/Standard Code pages can technically store new rows, but no code reads them. The 'Postpone Court' menu entry in System.ts has no Route or controller. The feature may live in another system (court/CAS): cannot verify from repo. No related maintenance ticket (grep adjourn in maintenance_tickets.csv found nothing).
recommendation: Do not claim as done. There is no e-adjournment code or per-ID-type configuration in the six repos. Ask URA/the team to confirm in which system this is built, or mark it as a gap

steps.step: Officer opens the e-adjournment configuration page in System Admin
steps.detail: The words adjourn, adjournment and variants (adj, e-adj, eadj) do not appear in src/properties of the six repos; the synonyms tried (postpone, hearing, mention, e-hearing, court appearance) gave a single trace: a 'Postpone Court' menu entry in System.ts (System.ts:16, 50, 139-142) that has no Route in App.tsx — the System Admin block only registers parameter, standardcode, computer-rule-code, suspension-reason and schedule-public-holiday (App.tsx:375-500) — and no controller. That menu entry is not evidence of an e-adjournment feature.

steps.step: Officer sets whether e-adjournment is allowed for each ID type (NRIC, FIN, company)
steps.detail: ID types are known to the system (N=NRIC, F=FIN, B=UEN, P=Passport; I_ID_TYPE_CODE in Istandardcode.d.ts:9, SystemConstant.java:97-100) but there is no flag, column, parameter or Standard Code category for e-adjournment: the Standard Code categories used by the UI (Istandardcode.d.ts:17-41) and the parameter_ids I found read by the backend (e.g. STAGEDAYS, POS, PDD, SUR, AFO, FOD, NEXT_STAGE, PERIOD) do not include it. The generic Parameter page can store new rows (ParameterController.java:48-76), but no code reads such a row.

steps.step: The setting is stored in the database and read when court cases are processed
steps.detail: The only court entity in ocmsadminapi, OcmsCourtCase, has just notice_no, court_payment_due_date and reason (OcmsCourtCase.java:17-31); there is no hearing, mention or adjournment entity and no ID type column. The paths /v1/courtmention, /v1/courttrial and /v1/courtcase only appear in the authorization mapping (api-authorization.properties:21-23) without a controller. Court processing lives outside this repo (CAS/PLUS send data through /plus-payment-activation); the system that decides e-adjournment: cannot verify from repo.
